source_go.authority: Lead-approved two-file local implementation only; no subdelegation or governance writes.

entry_board.authority: Root captures reused; no worker board or baseline suite.

baseline_case: Source-confirmed design case, not a claimed failed baseline runtime: live/manual/alarm/absorb mutated cached records before put; live/alarm personalization could be pushed before put; rejected or ambiguous writes could leave dirty or stale authoritative warm mirrors, while ownership-dependent paths diverged. Existing owner-refusal fixtures exposed the sticky marker semantics.
implementation: One shared persistAudienceState commits affinity/pipeline and the applicable exact owner payload, publishes mirrors only on resolution, and sets loaded=false on rejected or ambiguous put. Recovery reads actual storage; no automatic write retry or guessed rollback.

Live/manual/alarm/absorb derive local candidate records and candidate-aware update/enrichment before persistence, including nested attributes/segment and visitor references. Personalization push follows accepted put; later alarm/output failure does not roll back accepted records.

Historical import and buffered commits reuse the helper. Buffered storage still omits audienceOwner and preserves the existing cached marker without an ownership cast; absent/null/owned semantics and lifetime remain unchanged.

Load validates both non-null persisted records and enrichment before publishing any loaded mirror; explicit null retains prior nullish compatibility. Failed reload remains closed and can retry after storage repair.

One new grouped W35.01 case covers pre-put derivation failure, pending-write projections, serialized accepted updates, write-then-reject recovery across representative paths, failed reload, malformed enrichment, alarm commit ordering, post-commit alarm failure and ambiguous buffered commit. Existing failed-write expectations now assert recovery from actual stored authority.

canonical_source.basis: Unique union of baseline.owned_before, baseline.protected, accepted_dependencies.files excluding the two owned overlaps, and accepted_dependencies.review. Baseline fixes all unowned bytes; the final owned overrides below fix the final 95-pin map. No repeated source bodies/maps.
